name: Raissouni Palace
hero_subtitle: An early 20th-century Hispano-Moorish palace that hosts cultural events and workshops in Asilah.

overview.title: A palace for culture
overview.p1: Raissouni Palace reflects Asilah’s early 20th-century history and Hispano-Moorish style. It is linked to the town’s cultural life and sometimes opens for visits, workshops or festival events.
overview.p2: Check locally whether it is open during your stay — hours can vary. Even from outside, the building adds character to a medina walk.
overview.p3: Combine with the art medina and Borj Al-Kamra on the same loop.

1.title: Best during programmes
1.desc: Concerts, workshops or open days give the richest visit.

2.title: Architecture stop
2.desc: If open, a short visit fits a medina morning.

3.title: Façade only
3.desc: If closed, still worth seeing from the street.

food.title: Nearby food
food.p1: Medina and harbour options a short walk away.
food.p2: No permanent restaurant inside the palace.
